children: Gaurav mahajan brings 17 years of experience across finance, strategy, investments and commercial operations to the new role

Gaurav Mahajan has been appointed Chief Financial and Growth Officer at Lotus Singapore Group, taking responsibility for investments, capital allocation, growth initiatives and long-term value creation across its markets. He joins the organisation with more than 17 years of experience spanning corporate finance, strategy, investments, commercial operations and business leadership.

Mahajan is a Chartered Accountant and holds an MBA in Finance and Strategy from the Indian School of Business. His career has included roles across corporate environments, startups, venture capital and consulting.

Before joining Lotus Singapore Group, Mahajan spent more than four years with Adani Enterprises, where he held responsibilities across the Group CEO Office of Adani Natural Resources and contract administration for mining operations.
His work at Adani involved strategy, business reviews, performance improvement and coordination across operational, commercial, technical and legal functions.
Earlier, Mahajan was Head of Business Operations and Finance at Venture Highway, where he worked across finance and business operations.
He also spent four years with Carlsberg Group, holding roles in corporate development, strategy and projects. His responsibilities included strategic planning and corporate development initiatives.
Mahajan has also worked as an independent management consultant, handling projects related to supply chains, finance process restructuring, business planning and reporting.
At Lotus Singapore Group, Mahajan's role will cover the development of its investment engine, capital allocation and portfolio growth across Singapore and India.
The position brings together his experience in financial management, corporate strategy and commercial operations, with a broader mandate spanning investment and growth.
Mahajan's appointment comes as he moves into a role combining finance leadership with business and investment responsibilities.
